summary: This directory provides a collection of helper functions and utilities specifically designed to support unit and integration testing of the package analysis and rendering logic.
responsibilities: Providing test infrastructure for mocking file system environments
Generating mock package analysis data for test scenarios
Setting up local directories required for test execution
relationships: Test helpers provide pre-configured directory structures that serve as inputs for the package analysis process.
Mock package analysis objects are used to simulate the state of a project during the rendering phase of testing.
designDecisions: Centralization of boilerplate test setup logic
Decoupling of test scaffolding from production rendering code
